case: Current B4 branch rerun: a terminated transaction backend rolls back table data but not its identity sequence increment.
contract: The transaction inserts a row using an identity column, then blocks inside SELECT pg_sleep(60).
A monitor terminates the active PostgreSQL backend.
The driver returns TransactionRollbackFailed at statement index 1, with disconnected statement and rollback errors.
A fresh query confirms the row is absent.
A fresh sequence query confirms last_value is 1 and is_called is true.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration a_batch_reports_rollback_failure_after_postgres_terminates_its_backend -- --ignored --exact --test-threads=1

remaining: Frozen B3+B4 candidate rerun and hosted acceptance remain.
This documents the identity-sequence side effect only, not all PostgreSQL trigger, extension, or external effects.
